style_reference.policy: Native animation-frame extraction for style guidance only, without rescaling; source unchanged.

style_prompt: Standalone single lunar survival game world prop, NOT an inventory icon or UI frame. Native 2D pixel art for On My Way to Home, isometric-compatible 2:1 diamond ground plane, look down at top and two sides, matching the style reference astronaut and the project's white/blue robot Chiwis: sharp dark blue-gray outlines, white/cool gray surfaces, restrained blue accents, flat clustered pixel shading, light from upper left. Keep consistent pixel density relative to a 48-56 pixel tall human. Transparent background, crisp binary alpha, no antialiasing or blur. No text, numbers, logo, characters, scenery, floor tile, background or large structures. No ground shadow separate from object; use a tiny contact shadow only under the base. Full native canvas 64x64, preserve transparent padding. Single centered subject with base around canvas X=32,Y=52; no clipped pixels.
anchor_policy: Requested shared base around [32,52]. On export, measure actual visible base center and lowest opaque row+1, keep full canvas, and record ground anchor and negative Sprite2D offset. Do not move pixels to force anchoring.
